text: わたしね　わたしね　かわいいから　ピカチュウ　ほしい！

structure.jp: わたしね　わたしね
structure.en: me, you know, me, you know

structure.jp: ピカチュウ　ほしい！

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a describing word or verb gives the reason for what comes next. かわいいから = 'because it's cute'.

patterns.name: 〜がほしい
patterns.span: ピカチュウ　ほしい
patterns.explanation: ほしい after a thing says you want that thing. The が is dropped here, as children and casual speakers do. ピカチュウ　ほしい = 'I want a Pikachu'.
